title: Aagneyam
desc: Young and pure of heart, Madhavan is adored by every single one of his villagers. However, a false accusation of two murders alters the course of his life.

title: Chettayees
desc: Friends John, Kichu, Roopesh, Bava and Babumon decide to have a party on New Year's Eve. However, a series of events leads to a lot of unpleasantness and a rift between John and Kichu.

title: Janatha Garage
desc: When Anand visits Hyderabad, he encounters Sathyam, who operates an organisation aiding the underprivileged. Sathyam, swayed by Anand's vision, hands over the organisation's management to him.

desc: Unni, a bus owner, tries several ways to improve the condition of his bus, which is named after his late father. Things take a turn when the daughter of a powerful politician enters his life.

desc: Balachandran and Arundhathi love each other and get married after facing various obstacles. Problems arise when she must abort her unborn child due to a medical condition.
